crossRefs.note: “Yahweh’s Spirit spoke by me. His word was on my tongue.
For David himself said in the Holy Spirit, ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies…
If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your heavenly Father give the…
for I will give you a mouth and wisdom which all your adversaries will not be able to withstand or to contradict.
They were all filled with the Holy Spirit, and began to speak with other languages, as the Spirit gave them the ability…
Then Peter, filled with the Holy Spirit, said to them, “You rulers of the people, and elders of Israel,
They weren’t able to withstand the wisdom and the Spirit by which he spoke.
But he, being full of the Holy Spirit, looked up steadfastly into heaven and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing…
and said, “Behold, I see the heavens opened, and the Son of Man standing at the right hand of God!”
When they didn’t agree among themselves, they departed after Paul had spoken one word, “The Holy Spirit spoke rightly…
To them it was revealed, that they served not to themselves, but to you, in these things, which now have been announced…
For no prophecy ever came by the will of man: but holy men of God spoke, being moved by the Holy Spirit.
For the Gentiles seek after all these things; for your heavenly Father knows that you need all these things.
For the nations of the world seek after all of these things, but your Father knows that you need these things.

parallels.note: When they lead you away and deliver you up, don’t be anxious beforehand, or premeditate what you will say, but say…

translations.web: For it is not you who speak, but the Spirit of your Father who speaks in you.
translations.bsb: For it will not be you speaking, but the Spirit of your Father speaking through you.
translations.kjv: For it is not ye that speak, but the Spirit of your Father which speaketh in you.
translations.asv: For it is not ye that speak, but the Spirit of your Father that speaketh in you.
